definition.actual_eFG: sum(success * [1.5 if 3PT else 1]) / tracked xFG shots
definition.xEFG: sum(shotQuality * [1.5 if 3PT else 1]) / tracked xFG shots

partition: 17 modulo-20 originals + 8 modulo-60 rescues + 5 modulo-300 micro-rescues; exact non-overlapping coverage of all 1230 games
note: No missing xFG is imputed. Actual eFG and xEFG are compared on the identical set of NBA shots carrying public per-shot xFG.
